data.name: Interactive Equine Visitor Pass
data.headline: Enter the pasture and meet the horses 1:1
data.description:
*If you are staying with us, please add your discount code!*

#About 

This experience is very similar to our regular visitor pass; you will spend the first half getting to meet all the animals however, this pass also invites you into the pasture to meet the horses one on one. You will have the chance to groom and meet the horses on a more personal level.

Bringing carrots for the horses and grapes for the goats is still highly recommended to make the experience more special.

$45 per person 
Give us a call if you are a local or if your group is 5 or more for group discounts
data.cancellation_notes: Cancellations made at least 7 days prior to the session will receive a full refund. Please call to reschedule or receive a gift card. 100% will be charged for last minute cancellations. Chronic reschedules will get charged $15 per rescheduled session.
data.booking_notes:
Thanks for booking! 

Few friendly reminders: 
- please wear closed toe shoes. Whether it’s a van or a boot, as long as it’s closed. 
- each guest must sign their own waiver!
- carrots for the horses and grapes for the goats are HIGHLY recommended. 

See ya soon 😊
